content: Robo-advisors (Wealthfront, Betterment) use risk-tolerance questionnaires (goals, time horizon, comfort with risk) to slot users into a discrete number of model portfolios/risk levels (Wealthfront: 20 risk levels; Betterment: 100+ pre-defined allocations from 100% bonds to 100% stocks), with optional manual override of asset-class weights. Both add tax-optimization on top of the core allocation engine.
